description: A5b K=3 candidate G10 = depth-2 log-signature (10-d: increments + Levy areas of a 4-channel raw-acoustic path log-RMS/log-F0/centroid/ZCR, per-channel z-scored). Config A = K=2 with G10 replacing G5; Config B = K=3. 5 seeds, beta locked on train_threshold, reported devel_test. Two-dim gate: mean UAR > 0.7087 AND G10 speaker top-1 <= 0.0501.
